thread:
elaine: heads-up 3 weird drop after enabling embed L2-scaling on 7B-int8 reranker
sanjay: what metrics?
rachel: staging eval (webqa, 10k q): ndcg@10 decreased from 0.441 -> 0.402, mrr 0.285 -> 0.249 after turning on embed_scale=true
rachel: conversion used per-channel PTQ; no other changes
sanjay: sounds like magnitude-shift affecting softmax sharpness
mike: try L2-normalize before dot. tiny rescale can change top ranks
rachel: ran quick ablation:
```
./bin/eval_rerank --model models/7b-int8 --dataset webqa --embed-normalize false --temp 1.0 --seed 42
./bin/eval_rerank --model models/7b-int8 --dataset webqa --embed-normalize true  --temp 1.0 --seed 42
```
results: normalize false ndcg@10 0.402, normalize true ndcg@10 0.439
elaine: so quant+scale changed embedding norms, not semantic quality
sanjay: hypothesis: reduced activation range post-PTQ -> dot products shrink -> softmax flattens -> fewer decisive logits
mike: mitigations: L2-normalize, tune temp, or learn per-dataset scale/bias (calibrator)
rachel: tried brute-force scaling: *1.9 multiply embeddings -> ndcg@10 0.437
elaine: global scale recovers most, but may be dataset-specific
sanjay: plan: run across datasets (webqa, newsqa, internal-holdout) with grid-search for scale and temp. collect ndcg@1/5/10, mrr, top1-flip-rate
rachel: run matrix tonight: baseline float32, int8 raw, int8+norm, int8+global-scale (tuned), temps [0.3,0.6,1.0]
mike: record exact cmdline + seed + batch to avoid BK cache variance. use --batch 256, seed=42
